task: Comprehensive architectural refactoring of BukSU CMS-V2 across Phases 0-4 to implement canonical institutional workflow: strictly 2-4 team formation, 1-10 proposal pre-scan with SDGs & IT disciplines, sequential chapter submission pipeline (Ch 1-3), adviser Gantt approval gate before filling days, weekly sprint tracking, prototype showcase & verified GitHub code repo, BukSU 1.00-5.00 grading engine with RE_DEFENSE_REQUIRED, 5-role ADM signoff, calendar deadline wiring, and auto-archival with prototype/media visibility.

rootCause.workflowDivergence: The system previously allowed fragmented workflows: team size validation was lax in certain service endpoints, grading did not follow BukSU's 10-tier 1.00-5.00 point scale, defense decisions lacked the institutional RE_DEFENSE_REQUIRED verdict, Gantt charts allowed day editing without adviser pre-approval, deadlines were not integrated into the defense scheduler calendar, and GitHub repository links / prototype media were not surfaced in the archive or submission reviews.

solutionApplied: SG1: Extended @cms/shared with RE_DEFENSE_REQUIRED in defenseDecisions.js, created grades.js (BukSU 1.00-5.00 10-tier scale, computeBukSUGrade, color indicators), and capstonePhases.js (CAPSTONE_SEMESTER_MAP: Capstone 1 = 1st Sem, Capstone 2 = 2nd Sem, Capstone 3 = 3rd Sem).

SG2: Enhanced server project schema with ganttApprovalSchema (status, approvedAt, approvedBy, remarks) and githubRepoUrl. Added updateGithubRepoUrl and updateGanttApproval endpoints. Enforced strictly 2-4 member roster locking in team.service.js.
SG3: Upgraded server evaluation model and service with percentage, buksuGrade, and auto-computation via computeBukSUGrade.

SG4: Implemented Adviser Gantt Pre-Approval Gate in AcademicExcelGanttChart.jsx with institutional alert banners, approval/revision actions for advisers, and strict cell edit locking for students until approval is granted.

SG5: Wired chapter submission and defense deadlines directly into DefenseScheduleCalendar.jsx, displaying purple milestone badges on dates and adding late justification submission dialog in DeadlineWarning.jsx.
SG6: Exposed verified GitHub repository URL and prototype gallery media across SubmissionDetailPage, SubmissionReviewPage, ArchiveSearchPage, and CanonicalDocumentViewer via PrototypeGalleryModal.

SG7: Synchronized CapstoneWorkflowStepper.jsx with semester tags (Phase 0, Proposal, Phase 1 1st Sem, Phase 2 2nd Sem, Phase 3 3rd Sem), integrated BukSUGradeChip and RE_DEFENSE_REQUIRED into EvaluationPanel.jsx, and integrated PrototypeShowcaseAndDemo into Capstone2CollapsibleSections.jsx.

SG8: Deterministic verification passed: check:endpoints (0 unmatched), validate:agentic (60/60 checks passed), server integration suites (teams: 27/27, projects: 74/74, evaluations: 22/22 passed), client component tests passed, and Playwright visual audits passed across desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844 in light and dark modes.
